BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the IVIunicipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use

District symbols as shown on Map No. l l - I

in the area bounded by:



The alley next north of and parallel to West Irving Park Road; a line 33.30 feet east of

and parallel to North Whipple Street; West Irving Park Road; and North Whipple

Street.



To those of a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District, as amended.




SECTION 2. This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.
